ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces GATGLP, a graph attention network predicting HOMO–LUMO gaps for scarce ionic molecules via transfer learning, enabling dual-descriptor screening of 378 quaternary ammonium additives. It pioneers deep-learning-guided electrolyte engineering, accelerating discovery beyond inefficient trial-and-error screening.

💡 This work introduces molecular gating of water's hydrogen-bond network using 4-hydroxy-2-butanone as a dual-site modulator, fragmenting cooperative water domains and reshaping Zn2+ solvation.
